definitions.explanation: A surface or view produced by cutting straight across an object, perpendicular to its long axis. Used in engineering, anatomy, and geology.

examples.english: Draw a cross section in a diagram.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{横断面|おうだんめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{年輪|ねんりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Growth rings are visible in the cross section of the tree.

examples.japanese: ⟦トンネル→トンネル：03865_tonneru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{横断面|おうだんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{構造|こうぞう}→構造：02730_kouzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Looking at the cross section of the tunnel makes its structure clear.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{横断|おうだん}→横断：01906_oudan⟧ (crossing transversely) and ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (surface, face).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横断面|おうだんめん}⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧: cross-sectional diagram
- {横断面|おうだんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take a cross section

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{断面|だんめん}→断面：21317_danmen⟧: cross section, cut surface — the general term, without specifying direction
- {縦断面|じゅうだんめん}: longitudinal section — a cut along the long axis
